doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Higgins, Hendrix and the spiritual path
title: Stan Getz and the drugs on the road
summary: On tour, Getz, a friend of Lloyd's, tells him to hand over his drugs for safety.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: One time we were on the road together and he got a - You gotta hear some of his stuff, cause I shouldn’t be bothering people. What?

So one time we were on the road, and I had my drugs and stuff. Getz was gettin’ high with me all the time. So by the time we’re getting ready for a separate tour, going separate, he said, “You better give me those drugs cause you could get in trouble with all that stuff. You really don’t need to carry... Charles it’s too much pressure on you. Give me the drugs, I’ll take care of them.” [Laughs] He’s a special guy.
